recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned composition featuring a central framed photograph of a musician playing an acoustic guitar, overlaid with elegant script and serif typography against a textured, dark brown background.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph is nested within a white border, creating a frame-within-a-frame effect.
Large-scale script lettering overlaps the lower half of the photograph and the outer background.
A high-contrast relationship between the white text and the deep amber/brown tones of the image.
coreInvariants: Combination of formal serif and expressive script fonts
Soft, natural window lighting in the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame, seated and leaning over the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar body serves as the primary visual anchor, being the brightest part of the central photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left title, move down to the musician, follow the sweeping script across the center, and land on the bottom-right metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer border features a dense, scratch-like texture that provides a dark 'frame' for the lighter central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burnt umber and chocolate brown (background and shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and ochre (highlights in the photo).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white (primary typography and photo border).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between dark shadows and bright white text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of a humanist serif and a fluid, connected formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Serif text uses lowercase for primary titles to feel approachable.
Script text features long, horizontal flourishes and varying line weights.
Small caps or lowercase used for secondary metadata.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'L' and 'T' have exaggerated loops.
The 'y' and 'g' in the script have deep descenders that cross into the line below.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a structured, lowercase serif and an organic, sweeping script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the humanist serif feel with bracketed terminals.
Provides the necessary elegance and horizontal flow for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A sepia-toned photograph of a man playing an acoustic guitar indoors by a window, framed by a thin white border, set against a dark brown background with a fine, hay-like or scratched texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a large, white, flowing script font across the bottom half. Add secondary titles in a small, white, lowercase serif font at the top-left and bottom-right corners.

verificationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible despite overlapping the image.
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the photo and background.
Verify the white border around the photo is crisp.

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the musician
postGenerationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia/brown?
Does the script font feel hand-written and fluid?
Is there a clear distinction between the framed photo and the textured border?
Is the serif text strictly lowercase as per the design style?
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Photo + White Frame + Textured Border + (Lowercase Serif + Flourished Script)
